purpose: qualify URM-native K2 diagonal recurrence against the pinned FLA HGRN operator (native replacement, not dispatch overhead)

methodology.comparison: URM-native diagonal recurrence kernel vs pinned FLA HGRN; the two share no kernel
methodology.correctness_comparator: fla.ops.hgrn.fused_recurrent_hgrn (exact sequential recurrence) plus an independent eager oracle; output/final-state/input-gradients/state-gradients verified
methodology.performance_comparator: fla.ops.hgrn.chunk_hgrn (competitive chunked parallel kernel); the fastest compatible upstream kernel is the performance baseline, not a slow reference
methodology.timed_work: one native plan call or one upstream call, in each matrix mode (training forward, training forward+backward, inference prefill, single-token decode)
methodology.sampling: paired interleaved native/direct calls, order alternates, synchronized wall and CUDA event timing; each timed unit is a block of invocations to amortize per-call mistiming overhead
methodology.overhead: median of per-pair (native-direct)/direct fractions with bootstrap CI
methodology.gate_basis: the 95% confidence-interval upper bound must meet the budget
